<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Trang-1" id="5cE449nGy6EbXxTWqn5U"> <mxGraphModel dx="471" dy="275" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
' =========================================================================
' CẤU HÌNH KHỐI 3D UML CHUẨN & THU GỌN CHIỀU NGANG (TOP TO BOTTOM)
' =========================================================================
top to bottom direction
skinparam shadowing true
skinparam componentStyle uml2
skinparam defaultFontName \"Segoe UI\"
skinparam defaultFontSize 11
skinparam nodesep 25
skinparam ranksep 35

skinparam node {
 BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
 BorderColor #333333
}
skinparam component {
 BackgroundColor #F8F9FA
 BorderColor #495057
}
skinparam artifact {
 BackgroundColor #FFF9DB
 BorderColor #F08C00
}
skinparam database {
 BackgroundColor #EBFBEE
 BorderColor #2B8A3E
}

title UML Deployment Diagram (3D) - Hệ thống BrewLite (Vercel + Render + Docker Hub + SePay/VietQR)

' =========================================================================
' TẦNG 1: THIẾT BỊ NGƯỜI DÙNG + MÔI TRƯỜNG CI/CD + MÔI TRƯỜNG LOCAL
' =========================================================================
together {
 node \"Node: Thiết bị người dùng (Browser/PWA)\n[iOS / Android / Desktop]\" as UserDevice #E7F5FF {
 artifact \"manifest.json & icons\n(standalone, start_url: '/menu')\" as Manifest
 component \"Service Worker (public/sw.js)\n[Cache Static & App Shell]\" as ServiceWorker
 component \"Mobile-first UI & Client Store\n- cart.store.ts & auth.store.ts\n- price-calculator.ts\n- idempotency.ts (UUID Key)\" as ClientApp
 component \"HTTP Client (api-client.ts)\n[Bearer JWT & Idempotency-Key]\" as ApiClient
 
 ServiceWorker -[hidden]down- ClientApp
 ClientApp -down-> ApiClient : Gọi dịch vụ
 }

 node \"Ranh giới: Môi trường CI/CD\n(GitHub Actions + Docker Hub)\" as CIBoundary #FFF4E6 {
 artifact \"GitHub Secrets\n(DOCKERHUB_TOKEN,\nRENDER_WEBHOOK)\" as GHSecrets
 component \"GitHub Actions Pipeline\n1. Install -> Lint -> Test (Jest)\n2. Build Image (apps/api/Dockerfile)\n3. Push lên Docker Hub\n4. Trigger Render Deploy Webhook\" as GHRunner
 database \"Container Registry\nDocker Hub\n[brewlite-api:<sha>]\" as DockerHub
 
 GHSecrets .down.> GHRunner : Cấp phát Secret
 GHRunner -down-> DockerHub : Push Image\n(HTTPS:443)
 }

 node \"Ranh giới: Môi trường Local\n(Docker Compose)\" as LocalBoundary #F8F9FA {
 component \"Monorepo Local Dev\n- apps/web (:3000)\n- apps/api (:4000)\n- postgres-local (:5432)\" as LocalStack
 component \"Test Suite (tests/)\n- Jest / RTL (Unit)\n- Playwright / Cypress (E2E)\" as LocalTests
 artifact \".env.local /\n.env.example\" as LocalEnv
 
 LocalEnv .down.> LocalStack : Cấu hình
 LocalTests .up.> LocalStack : Chạy Test
 }
}

' =========================================================================
' TẦNG 2 & 3: RANH GIỚI MÔI TRƯỜNG PRODUCTION & DỊCH VỤ BÊN THỨ 3
' =========================================================================
node \"Ranh giới: Môi trường Production (Hạ tầng PaaS Miễn phí: Vercel & Render)\" as ProdBoundary #F1F3F5 {

 ' --- KHỐI FRONTEND TRÊN VERCEL ---
 node \"Node: CDN/Next.js service (Nền tảng Vercel)\n[Host apps/web - Global CDN & SSL/HTTPS Port 443]\" as VercelNode #FFF9DB {
 component \"Vercel Global CDN\n(Code Splitting, Static Assets)\" as VercelCDN
 component \"Next.js App Router (src/app/)\n- /menu, /menu/[id], /cart\n- /login, /register\n- /checkout (Hiển thị mã VietQR)\n- /orders, /orders/[id]\" as NextAppRouter
 component \"API Services (src/services/)\n- product / auth / order / payment\" as NextServices
 artifact \"Vercel Env\nNEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL\" as VercelEnv

 VercelCDN -down-> NextAppRouter : Route
 NextAppRouter -down-> NextServices : Fetch
 VercelEnv .up.> NextServices : Inject URL
 }

 ' --- KHỐI BACKEND TRÊN RENDER WEB SERVICE ---
 node \"Node: NestJS container (Render Web Service - Docker)\n[apps/api/Dockerfile - Auto HTTPS: 443 -> Internal Port: 4000]\" as RenderApiNode #F3F0FF {
 component \"API Gateway & Guards\n- JwtAuthGuard (Bearer Token)\n- ValidationPipe & Idempotency\" as NestGateway
 component \"NestJS Domain Modules\n- Product, Auth, Order\n- Promotion, Loyalty\" as NestModules
 component \"PaymentModule & Webhook Handler\n- POST /payments (Tạo QR & Idempotency)\n- POST /payments/sepay-webhook\" as PaymentModule
 component \"Data Access (Prisma/TypeORM)\n[Transaction & Row Locking]\" as PrismaDAL
 interface \"GET /health\" as HealthCheck

 NestGateway -down-> NestModules : Xử lý
 NestGateway -down-> PaymentModule : Điều phối thanh toán
 NestModules -down-> PrismaDAL : Transaction
 PaymentModule -down-> PrismaDAL : Lưu Payment & Order PAID
 NestModules -up- HealthCheck
 }

 ' --- KHỐI DATABASE & LOG/SECRET ĐẶT PHÍA DƯỚI ---
 together {
 node \"Node: Render PostgreSQL (Free - Private Network)\n[Internal Port: 5432 - Không Public ra Internet]\" as RenderDbNode #D3F9D8 {
 database \"PostgreSQL 16 Instance\n- users, products, promotions\n- orders, order_items\n- payments, loyalty_transactions\" as PostgresDB
 folder \"Persistent Storage Volume\n[Lưu trữ bền vững & Migration]\" as PGVolume
 
 PostgresDB *-right- PGVolume : Mount SSD
 }

 node \"Node: Render Secrets & Observability\" as RenderOpsNode #FFE3E3 {
 artifact \"Render Environment (.env / Secrets)\n- DATABASE_URL (Internal URL)\n- JWT_SECRET, PORT=4000\n- SEPAY_API_KEY / WEBHOOK_SECRET\" as RenderSecrets
 component \"Render Health Monitor & Log Stream\n- Thu thập JSON Logs (stdout/stderr)\n- Ping GET /health (Auto-restart)\" as RenderLogger
 }
 }
}

' =========================================================================
' NODE DỊCH VỤ THANH TOÁN BÊN THỨ 3 (SEPAY & VIETQR)
' =========================================================================
node \"Ranh giới: Dịch vụ Thanh toán Bên thứ 3 (External Payment Gateway)\" as ExternalPaymentBoundary #FFF0F6 {
 node \"Node: SePay & VietQR Service\n[Cổng thanh toán QR & Đối soát giao dịch]\" as SePayNode #FFDEEB {
 component \"VietQR Generator Service\n[Sinh ảnh mã QR chuyển khoản động\ntheo mã đơn & số tiền]\" as VietQRService
 component \"SePay Payment & Webhook Engine\n[Giả lập/Xác nhận biến động số dư\n& bắn Webhook IPN về Backend]\" as SePayEngine
 }
}

' =========================================================================
' CÁC ĐƯỜNG KẾT NỐI GIAO THỨC & CỔNG MẠNG (CHUẨN CÚ PHÁP)
' =========================================================================

' 1. Từ Thiết bị người dùng xuống Vercel và Render
ServiceWorker --> VercelCDN : HTTPS (Port 443)\n[Tải PWA & Giao diện]
ApiClient --> NestGateway : HTTPS (Port 443)\n[REST API + JWT + Idempotency-Key]

' 2. Giữa Vercel (Next.js) và Render (NestJS)
NextServices -right-> NestGateway : HTTPS (Port 443 -> 4000)\n[SSR Fetch /products]

' 3. Giữa CI/CD (GitHub Actions + Docker Hub) và Render
DockerHub ..> RenderApiNode : Pull Docker Image (HTTPS:443)
GHRunner ..> RenderApiNode : Trigger Deploy Webhook
GHRunner ..> HealthCheck : Smoke Test (GET /health)

' 4. Giữa NestJS Container và Render PostgreSQL
PrismaDAL --> PostgresDB : Internal Database URL\n(Private TCP: 5432)

' 5. Luồng Secrets, Health Check và Logs trên Render
RenderSecrets .up.> NestGateway : Inject Secrets (.env)
NestModules .down.> RenderLogger : Xuất JSON Logs
RenderLogger -up-> HealthCheck : Ping /health (30s)

' 6. Luồng tích hợp Thanh toán bên thứ 3 (SePay & VietQR)
PaymentModule --> VietQRService : HTTPS (Port 443)\n[1. Yêu cầu tạo mã VietQR\nkèm nội dung mã đơn]
SePayEngine --> PaymentModule : HTTPS POST Webhook (Port 443)\n[2. Callback xác nhận giao dịch\n(Header: Authorization / Apikey)]
ClientApp ..> VietQRService : HTTPS (Port 443)\n[Hiển thị ảnh mã VietQR\ntrên màn hình Checkout]
